verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Each takes the centred headline/subline/pill stack and simply shrinks it uniformly, with no rearranging. The headline now fills only about 57% of the width where the original used about 80%, so it wastes the extra horizontal room of the wider banner. The CTA label 'Shop the Drop' and the 'Voltstride Drop 07' subline become small and weak at this size. The stack is centred and on brand with no collisions, but it reads as a scaled-down copy rather than a resize fitted to the banner.
